why: Printer profiles the Snapmaker Orca-based engine can't slice yet. Their start G-code needs upstream OrcaSlicer's multi-nozzle system (filament_map, nozzle groups, chamber hold), which Snapmaker Orca's engine doesn't have. Owner decision 2026-09-27: hidden until that system is ported and tested on a real machine, never filled with single-nozzle stand-ins. See docs/upstream/PROVENANCE.md P-0007.
